notes: CardDemo job CREASTMT (app/jcl/CREASTMT.JCL), steps STEP010 (DFSORT, lowered by det/dfsort.py), STEP020 (IDCAMS REPRO, the model in det/idcams_model.py) and STEP040 (CBSTM03A, which CALLs CBSTM03B: a case with subprograms), wired in JCL order. DELDEF01 (DELETE / DEFINE CLUSTER of the KSDS) is not a step here: the KSDS starts empty and its definition is the STEP020 DD spec; STEP030 (IEFBR14 deleting the statement files) is not run. IBM ends this job at STEP010 (`ibm_stops`): its OUTREC builds 328-byte records (16 + 262 + 50) while the JCL states LRECL=350 for SORTOUT, so DFSORT terminates with ICE043A reason code 9 (z/OS DFSORT Messages, Codes and Diagnosis Guide SC23-6879) and COND=(0,NE) bypasses the later steps. The harness proves STEP010 on both sides and reports STEP020 and STEP040 as not reached; no pad is guessed (register F4). The later steps stay declared so the wiring is checked and the chain runs once the join is padded. Assumption: the JCL wiring is this file, not a read job (register F4).
